'''Kess Bela''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Cala (planet)|Cala]] and [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kess Bela was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In contrast, the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]], claims that the Ilum [[Star system/Legends|system]] did not contain any [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belts.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
